ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: Promote and Deploy starts a deployment with no chance to confirm, so it is never allowed on a bypassed story that still has issues.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Story_Verification_Control__c.Disable_Story_Verification__c), copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c)), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Issues"), Bypass_Verification__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification for this story was bypassed, but it still has issues. Promote and Deploy is not allowed. Check Ready to Promote instead and deploy from the promotion.
